name: PC110 Atlas
summary:
How did an entire 486 computer fit in the palm of a hand? PC110 Atlas lets you take a close look at the 1995 Palm Top PC110 and the research that reconstructed its electronics.

Use tracked controllers to open the lid, turn the laptop over, or enlarge it for a closer look at its keys and controls. Point at a key, the TrackPoint, or the handwriting pad to see an explanation on the laptop display. Switch on See-through to place the model in your room.
